title.value: A Framework for Fair Decision-making Over Time with Time-invariant Utilities
title.justification: The value chosen is the actual title of the paper provided in the prompt.
title.quote: A Framework for Fair Decision-making Over Time with Time-invariant Utilities

extractions.description: The paper presents a mathematical programming framework focused on fairness in repeated decision-making scenarios involving multiple stakeholders. The framework addresses fairness by providing a mathematical structure that allows the aggregation of stakeholder utility over time and proposes a strong reformulation to aid computational efficiency. The context includes general decision-making problems beyond resource allocation, emphasizing repeated decisions as a means to reduce unfairness. Additionally, the paper discusses techniques for solving these problems and insights into achieving fairness.
